current_phase: Production SQLite + YOLOv11 model/reference integration verified; final IEEE implementation documentation

milestones.title: CircuitVision website
milestones.detail: Existing upload and live camera model selection preserved. A new SQLite relational catalog serves component reference data through GET /api/components, GET /api/components/{label}, and model inference response joins. Release pending passing tests and Render smoke verification.

milestones.title: Live YOLO detection
milestones.detail: The production live camera uses the team's Round 2 YOLO11n detector and browser motion tracking. Android camera quality and moving-object accuracy still require hands-on validation.

milestones.title: Photo detection expansion
milestones.detail: Still images use the team-trained core model, with optional additional Round 3 predictions. Small-object tiling is enabled for large photographs.

milestones.title: Sam's detailed component recognition
milestones.detail: Ten specialist classes and fusion logic are prepared; the verified specialist ONNX checkpoint has not yet been installed on the hosted service.

milestones.title: One jointly trained YOLO11 model
milestones.detail: 87-class candidate ONNX was uploaded to models/unified_87.onnx and deployed to the existing Render service as user-selectable YOLOv11 (2). It is not the default and remains experimental: small photo test missed a green LED and misclassified a 9V battery. Real production API smoke tests and broader evaluation are required.

milestones.title: Real laboratory evaluation
milestones.detail: The independent Colab ZIP uploaded on 21 Oct contains empty CSV headers. Local ONNX run used five previous photos; independence from training photos is not verified. More annotated novel lab and negative-control photos plus true-held-out class metrics are required.

milestones.title: SQLite relational component information
milestones.detail: SQLite normalized catalog is live on the existing Render service. 90 component/guide records, 17 categories and 87 mapped unified-model class links seeded from team-authored references and class map; GET /api/components queries and individual reference retrieval passed real production tests. POST /api/detect joins genuine predictions with component_info. Database is seeded idempotently at startup on ephemeral Render filesystem; user-made runtime edits do not persist across deploys.

recent_updates.title: Production database live lookup verified
recent_updates.detail: Render deployed SQLite component catalog release 49abe2090cfc585838c5b1b73983079aabf1a689. GitHub remote smoke PR #17 confirmed database_ready=true, database_component_count=90, database_model_2_class_links=87, both models available and valid lookup for Resistor, LCD OLED and filtered search. Automated tests and relational foreign-key checks passed; user image data is not saved. Final paper may now describe implemented database rather than proposed database, with ephemeral storage limitation.

recent_updates.title: Prepare actual relational SQLite component-information integration
recent_updates.detail: Added normalized schema, 17 source category records (16 authored + general fallback), 90 class/guide labels, 87 YOLOv11 (2) model mappings, database read APIs, inference-response joins, frontend reference retrieval, setup scripts and software tests. Public YOLO models and training metrics unchanged. Real SQLite on default Render filesystem will be reconstructed after restarts rather than persistent for writes.

recent_updates.title: Actual YOLOv11 (2) checkpoint installed alongside default detector
recent_updates.detail: Verified GitHub model file 10,748,517 bytes matches candidate export SHA-1 9ae95428d68c8bfacc5d2b516598506ecc8ebe83. Render deployed commit 553d003862e6478324c6ef9376aa93525acf29e7 as live. Added a real-API smoke test for both selectable models; deployment is not a claim of improved accuracy.

recent_updates.title: User-selectable YOLOv11 (1) and YOLOv11 (2) website integration
recent_updates.detail: Added independent selection to both Upload and Live Camera. Model (1) remains the current trained detector and default. Model (2) uses the 87-class candidate with a separate ONNX file and correct class mapping, and the option remains disabled until installed. No public internal round/team names; classification limitations retained in private development record.

recent_updates.title: Local 87-class ONNX photo results reveal missed LED and incorrect battery class
recent_updates.detail: Five supplied images tested at confidence 0.35: green LED none; resistor_01 predicted Resistor 52K 0.4905 (value unverified); 9V battery predicted LCD OLED 0.7289; resistor_02 predicted Resistor 0.8262; unrelated object none. These are diagnostic examples, not percentage accuracy. New model intentionally not deployed. GitHub issue #12 tracks fixes.

recent_updates.title: Unified candidate training completed; production activation held for validation
recent_updates.detail: Received CircuitVision_Unified_YOLO11_Candidate.zip containing best.pt, best.onnx, an 87-class label map, dataset sources and training report. Selected refinement stage. Notebook reports 0.6995 test mAP@50 and 0.4750 mAP@50–95; no independent real-photo tests have yet been run and no new deployment has been made. A separate Colab validation notebook and written audit were prepared.

recent_updates.title: Live camera bounding-box stability work
recent_updates.detail: The user verified image-upload component identification but reports weaker live-camera accuracy. Camera tracking now preserves stable IDs for matched YOLO detections, dampens only small localization jitter, expires old boxes after 3 seconds, and displays round-trip latency. Live still uses the faster existing model while the unified Colab candidate awaits validation; changes improve presentation/tracking but do not establish classification accuracy improvement on real moving objects.

recent_updates.title: Repair Android PNG uploads rejected before YOLO inference
recent_updates.detail: Investigated an actual HTTP 415 response to an Android upload on the production website. Browser-side image normalization now decodes supported phone photos and sends a bounded RGB JPEG without changing the displayed original. Large source dimensions get an accurate 413 response; tests cover 6250px source images. Detection confidence is unchanged and further testing of actual handset photos remains necessary.

recent_updates.title: Public CircuitVision UI now uses a unified YOLOv11 identity
recent_updates.detail: Removed developer training timelines, model-round names and specialist model references from visible pages. Replaced with a clean About view and feature-focused navigation; detailed research/model provenance remains maintained privately in the GitHub project ledger.

recent_updates.title: Fixed outdated text persisting in mobile browser cache
recent_updates.detail: The website now serves no-cache HTML, scripts and styles, with release-versioned asset URLs, so Android Chrome will request the latest project About page after reopening or refreshing.

recent_updates.title: Progress-update safeguards tested
recent_updates.detail: GitHub checks require feature changes to review public status; milestones can advance once actual model evidence becomes available.

recent_updates.title: Project progress is now shown on the About page
recent_updates.detail: A versioned project status and live deployment/model details distinguish completed work from testing and planned work.

recent_updates.title: Website wording and mobile layout reviewed
recent_updates.detail: Removed outdated EESOB-era claims and corrected oversized workflow panels and horizontal overflow.

recent_updates.title: Detection workflow updated
recent_updates.detail: Added still-image small-object tiling, safe optional specialist integration, and browser-tracking safeguards without claiming new measured accuracy.

limitations: YOLO labels, confidence scores and bounding boxes are predictions, not proof of per-class accuracy or electrical measurements. Exact resistor resistance must be checked from markings or with suitable measurement equipment.
